title: MPX EncounterPlus V5 Encounter Reference
description: Source reference to an individual encounter exported from EncounterPlus V5.

name.markdownDescription: *Required.* Display name of the encounter. This value replaces the name stored in the EncounterPlus export.

path.markdownDescription: *Required.* Relative path to the individual ZIP exported from EncounterPlus V5. Save the ZIP directly inside the `encounters` folder at the project root.
path.patternErrorMessage: The path must use the form encounters/file-name.zip and point to a ZIP stored directly inside the project's encounters folder.

slug.markdownDescription: *Required.* Stable text identifier without accents or spaces. Separate words with hyphens. Each content item in the module must use a different slug.
slug.patternErrorMessage: The slug must contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (no spaces, accents, or uppercase).

rank.markdownDescription: *Required.* Numeric order among contents sharing the same parent.

parent.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Slug of the parent page or group. Leave empty to place the encounter at the module root.

descr.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Description of the encounter. This value replaces the description stored in the EncounterPlus export, including when left empty.
examples: An ambush staged along the forest road.
